mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances during FEDFUNDS decline periods, or Rank IC <0.05 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 10.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened unemployment concerns.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 10.0% in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly demand (GDPC1) and monthly demand (HOUST) simultaneously signal expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both proxies rise in their respective periods
failure_condition: Rank IC for combined proxies <0.03 over 3-month window, or 20d returns not positive when both rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index predicts stronger production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive in >70% of INDPRO rising periods, or Rank IC <0.05 over 6mo.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.0% in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) and quarterly demand (GDPC1) together signal robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both proxies rise in their respective periods
failure_condition: Rank IC for combined proxies <0.03 over 3-month window, or 20d returns not positive when both rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% strengthens the easing signal, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS below 1.5% instances during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained fall in the INDPRO supply index below 95.0 indicates weakening production, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO falling below 95.0 in >70% of cases.
